snippet.title: Deserter Prologue Trailer
snippet.description:
Deserter: Prologue is a free stealth-RPG game. Use stealth, cunning, and thieving skills to escape from a military camp in the heart of a dystopian war.
Release in August 2025.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688740/Deserter_Prologue/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248910/Deserter/
